#en: The trail bends back to this nowhere patch of rock for a reason; signals do not linger out here by accident. This region has a habit of holding onto things longer than anyone plans, from derelict beacons to half-scrubbed comm bursts that never quite clear the buffer. Whatever trace MacLeod left when he slipped past UC eyes, it bled into the local noise and stayed, waiting for someone patient enough to sift it out. So far, I have a dead agent's notes, a stray dataslate from the fringe, and settlers whispering about armed escorts and impossible harvests, all pointing to one man who understands how to hide a lifeline inside routine traffic.
zh: 线索绕回这块鸟不拉屎的岩石是有原因的；信号不会凭空滞留在这里。这片区域有个习惯，会把东西留得比任何人计划的都久，从废弃的信标到从未真正清出缓冲区的半擦除通讯脉冲。麦克劳德溜过联殖眼皮时留下的痕迹，渗进了本地噪声并留了下来，等着某个足够有耐心的人把它筛出来。目前为止，我有一名死掉特工的笔记、一块来自边境的散落数据板，以及定居者们关于武装护航和不可能收成的窃窃私语——全都指向一个懂得如何把生命线藏进日常交通里的人。

#en: Out in the quiet drift where nobody bothers to look twice at a forgotten buoy, this is the only place a careful man could stash revisions to entire harvest plans without raising alarms. The patterns etched into those figures will show where he has been seeding bad promise into marginal worlds, and which neglected corridors he trusts to move between them unseen. The numbers have been sitting here long enough that patrols, traders, even smugglers learned to steer past on habit alone. So far, the trail runs from a dead farmstead to warped orbital readings and a hushed cargo ledger, all pointing to one surveyor quietly rewriting the frontier.
zh: 在那片安静的漂流带里，没人会对着一个被遗忘的浮标多看一眼——这正是唯一能让一个谨慎之人藏起整份收成计划修订而不惊动任何人的地方。刻进那些数字里的图案，会显示他一直在哪些边缘世界播下虚假的许诺，以及他信任哪些无人问津的走廊、好让自己在它们之间神不知鬼不觉地穿行。这些数字在这儿搁得够久了，巡逻队、商人、甚至走私者都只凭习惯就学会绕开它。目前为止，线索从一座死掉的农场，延伸到扭曲的轨道读数与一份沉默的货运账册，全都指向同一名在暗中改写边境的勘探员。

#en: Out here, the mech wreckage spins slowly, broadcasting combat diagnostics long after the pilot is dust. Those echoes are not random; someone has been nudging targeting data and movement logs a fraction off true, using old war hardware as a relay for cleaner tricks elsewhere. If this fragment keeps drifting, every later trail will be laced with false engagements and misfiled skirmishes, hiding the patterns I am trying to see. So far I have a quietly reversed foreclosure on a Freestar world, a scratched dataslate in forgotten dirt, and a jump node whose timing felt wrong, all small anomalies that, stacked together, look a lot like intention.
zh: 在这里，那具机甲残骸缓缓旋转，驾驶员早已化为尘土，它却仍在广播战斗诊断数据。那些回响并非随机；有人一直在把瞄准数据与运动日志往偏离真实的方向推上一点点，把旧日的战争硬件当作中继，好在别处玩更干净的把戏。若这块碎片继续漂下去，之后每一条线索都会被虚假交火与归档错误的遭遇战缠绕，从而遮住我正试图看清的模式。目前为止，我有一颗自由星系联盟世界上被悄然撤销的止赎、一块被划花的、丢在遗忘尘土里的数据板，以及一个时机感觉不对的跃迁节点——这些细小的异常堆在一起，很像是有意为之。

#en: Ryujin keeps its real maps behind glass and smiles, and this tower is where those routes are bought, erased, and quietly rewritten. Only here do corporate shipping logs, black clinic contracts, and off the books transit corridors intersect in a way that can trace one pilot who never flies the same line twice. To understand where he is going, you need to see which grav spikes their executives pretend not to notice, and which runs never make it onto official schedules at all. So far the trail is a chain of scrubbed sensor buoys, a silenced freighter in high orbit, and nervous settlers who swear their rescuer flew a ship no registry will own.
zh: 龙神集团把真正的地图藏在玻璃与微笑之后，而这座塔正是那些航线被买下、抹除、并被悄悄改写的地方。只有在这里，公司航运日志、地下诊所合同与账外的运输走廊才会以某种方式交错，从而追踪到一个从不飞同一航线两次的飞行员。要弄懂他要去哪儿，你得看清哪些引力尖峰是他们的高管假装没注意到的，以及哪些航次根本从未出现在官方日程上。目前为止，这条线索是一串被擦净的传感器浮标、一艘高轨道上被噤声的货船，以及紧张兮兮的定居者——他们发誓救自己的人开着一艘没有任何登记册愿意承认的船。

#en: The Red Mile is where the noise drowns out everything that matters, which makes it the safest place in the Settled Systems to hide the kind of paperwork no one is meant to see. Down in the Medical Deck, between blood-slick stretchers and overstocked chem cabinets, the gaps in the ledgers mean more than the entries do. Someone was supposed to come back, wipe the logs, clean the stains, finish erasing a dead doctor from the story, and never did. Back at that quiet garage, a too-clean table and missing chems were the first hint; now the same careful hand shows up in falsified accident reports and cargo transfers that never delivered a single patient.
zh: 红里就是噪声淹没一切要紧之事的地方，这也让它成为整个定居星系里藏起那种"没人该看到"之文件的最安全之地。在下面的医疗甲板，在血迹黏滑的担架与堆积过剩的药物柜之间，账册里的空缺比条目本身更能说明问题。本该有人回来擦掉日志、清掉污渍、把一名死去的医生从故事里彻底抹去，但那人始终没回来。回到那间安静的修车行，一张干净得过分的桌子和失踪的药剂是第一条线索；如今，同一只谨慎的手又出现在伪造的事故报告与从未送过一名病人的货物转运单上。

#en: The farm feels impossibly far from any proper route, but the silence here is exactly why someone would hide a lifetime of call records and quietly altered orders among weather reports and crop yields. Out on the frontier, people learn to live with unanswered signals and missing ships; a few extra gaps in the logs do not raise alarms, especially when the losses are written off to bad luck and old drives. Only after that first stray slate on a dead rock and the strange omissions buried in a forgotten depot does it become clear that every missing timestamp, every delayed response, has been drifting toward the same quiet places at the edge of the maps.
zh: 这座农场感觉离任何正经航线都远得不可思议，但此地的寂静，恰恰是有人会把一辈子的通话记录和被悄悄改动的指令藏进天气预报与作物产量里的原因。在边境，人们学会与无人应答的信号和失踪的船只共处；日志里多出几个空缺并不会拉响警报，尤其当损失被归咎于坏运气和旧引擎时。只有在死寂岩石上那块散落数据板、以及被遗忘货运站里埋着的古怪遗漏出现之后，才看得清：每一个失踪的时戳、每一次延迟的应答，都一直朝着星图边缘那些同样安静的地方漂去。

#en: The cache hangs in a quiet lane where traffic once passed so often no one bothered checking the fine print in the telemetry anymore. It is exactly the sort of blind spot a navigator obsessed with patterns would choose, hiding his work amid the routine drift of freighters and patrols that trust their charts too much. Pulling it apart here, in the same orbit everyone stopped looking at, is the only way to see how his corrections interlock, which routes he has been bending toward the dark. So far the trail runs from a forgotten outpost, to a skewed orbital buoy, to hushed accounts in Gagarin of ships that turned aside from disaster without knowing why.
zh: 那座储藏点悬在一条安静的航道上，那里曾经交通繁忙到再没人费心细看遥测里的明细。这正是一个痴迷于模式的领航员会挑中的盲点，把自己的作品藏进货船与巡逻队的日常漂流之中——他们太信任自己的星图了。在这里、在这个所有人都已不再留意的同一轨道上把它拆解开来，是看清他的修正如何彼此咬合、他一直在把哪些航线掰向黑暗的唯一办法。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的前哨，延伸到一座歪斜的轨道浮标，再到加加林星上关于船只在不知为何的情况下避开灾祸的低声叙述。

#en: If the pattern starts anywhere, it is here, in the humming throat of Neon where ships slide in and out under flickering neon and half-awake clerks wave them through. Berths that were never free suddenly open, cargoes no one remembers signing for depart on priority lanes, and every dockhand has a different version of why, each retelling shifting with fear or superstition. Somewhere in the back-end logs and whispered berth assignments is the first clear line pointing away from chance and toward a guiding hand. So far all I have is a dead slate in the dark and a growing stack of rumors about an auditor who walked off with the keys to other people's debts.
zh: 若说这个模式有起点，那就是这里——霓虹城嗡鸣的咽喉，船只在闪烁的霓虹下进进出出，半梦半醒的文书挥手放行。本该永远满员的泊位突然空出来，没人记得自己签过字的货物从优先航道上启程，而每个码头工对"为什么"都有一套不同说法，每一次重述都随着恐惧或迷信而变形。在后端日志与被低声交代的泊位安排里，某个地方藏着第一条清晰的线——它背离偶然，指向一只引导的手。目前为止，我只有黑暗中一块死掉的数据板，以及越堆越高的一摞传闻：一名审计员带着别人债务的钥匙扬长而去。

#en: Out here at the edge of a dusty pad, this crooked little trailer is where stories harden into something you can actually point to. The deputy has been sitting between bad coffee and worse lighting, chasing a pattern most captains laugh off as superstition, filing it under a different case so no one pulls their access. Whatever they logged here is the first thing that ties quiet ship failures and midnight "repairs" to real coordinates, not bar talk. So far the trail is all secondhand: spacer rumors about a masked hull savior, a staryard's name spoken softer than a curse, and scattered reports that accidents are clustering around the same invisible hand.
zh: 在这片积灰停机坪的边缘，这辆歪斜的小拖车，正是故事沉淀成你能实打实指着的东西的地方。那位副警长一直坐在劣质咖啡与更劣质灯光之间，追查着一个多数船长都当成迷信一笑置之的模式，把它归档在另一起案子里，好让没人翻出他的访问权限。他们在此记录下的东西，是第一件把悄无声息的船只故障与午夜"维修"系到真实坐标、而非酒吧闲谈上的物证。目前为止，这条线索全是二手的：太空劫匪们关于一位蒙面船体救星的传闻、一个被念得比诅咒还轻的船坞名字，以及零散的报告说事故正围绕着同一只无形的手聚集。

#en: The far-orbit relay skims just outside standard patrol sweeps, exactly where someone who knows the lanes too well would stash sensitive traffic. Its signal bleed overlaps two incompatible charts, like a ghost echo laid over the real sky, and the only reason anyone noticed is that a battered hauler called the BR-5033 Crackspine has been sitting on top of it for longer than any cargo job should last. Every account you have comes second-hand and half-corrupted: a burned buoy core full of bad vectors, dock logs that quietly disagree with transit stamps, and a Freestar deputy's notes about convoys that all vanished after buying the same discounted guidance.
zh: 那座远轨中继恰好掠过标准巡逻圈的边缘之外，正是一个对航道熟得过头的人会藏敏感交通的地方。它的信号溢出与两张互不兼容的星图重叠，像一道覆在真实天空上的幽灵回声，而唯一让人注意到它的原因，是一艘名为"BR-5033 裂脊"的破旧货船压在它上方的时间，比任何货运差事该有的都长。你手上的每份说法都是二手且半损坏的：一枚塞满错误向量的烧毁浮标核心、与运输印章悄悄对不上的船坞日志，以及一名自由星系联盟副警长关于车队在买下同样打折的导航后尽数消失的笔记。

#en: The rock remembers what the ledgers tried to forget. Down here, where old conveyor belts hang like dead vines and Deimos loaders rust in the dark, the shifts no one logged left their traces in dust and carbon scoring, in crates that carried no ore yet bled radiation. This is where the pattern of rerouted scrap and missing cores tightens, where off-the-books labor and sealed cargo intersected until the line between mining and dismantling black hardware blurred away. At the support ship we found doctored routes and half-erased consignment codes; small discrepancies, overlooked signatures, and one crew chief's name repeating where it never should have been.
zh: 这块岩石记得账本试图忘掉的东西。在这下面，旧传送带像死藤一样垂着，火卫二的装载机在黑暗中锈蚀，无人记录的班次把痕迹留在了尘土与焦痕里，留在了那些没装矿石却渗出辐射的箱子里。这里正是被改道废料与失踪核心这一模式收得最紧的地方——账外劳工与封存货物在此交汇，直到采矿与拆解黑色硬件之间的界线彻底模糊。在那艘支援船上，我们发现了被做手脚的航线与半擦除的托运编码；细小的对不上、被忽略的签名，以及一个本绝不该出现、却反复出现的工头名字。

#en: The cramped command trailer is where loose talk hardens into something dangerous; out here, patrols rotate, borders blur, and the only constant is whatever a harried Ranger pins to these walls. This is where the deputy started stitching together shipping manifests, patrol gaps, and whispered complaints from haulers who swore their routes felt wrong, then quietly filed everything under a case that was never officially opened. No one will speak plainly about it now, but the redacted copies, crossed-out names, and missing pages say enough. So far the trail is only a pattern of altered transit timings and a single, recurring spiral mark hiding in the margins.
zh: 这辆狭窄的指挥拖车，是闲话凝固成危险东西的地方；在这里，巡逻队轮换、边界模糊，唯一不变的，是一名焦头烂额的游骑兵钉在墙上的东西。那位副警长正是在这里开始把货运舱单、巡逻缺口，以及货船船员发誓自己航线不对劲的低声抱怨拼在一起，然后把一切都悄悄归进一宗从未正式立案的案子里。如今没人愿意把话说清，但那些涂黑的副本、被划掉的名字与缺失的页面已经说明够多了。目前为止，这条线索只是一个被改动的运输时点模式，以及一个反复出现、藏在页边的螺旋标记。

#en: It starts here, on a Trade Authority courier left to drift between lanes, where official channels are thin and inconvenient questions go unanswered. The Ironkeel TR-5394 floats in practiced neglect, its transponder still dutifully pinging a registry that pretends not to notice. This is where quiet edits to routes can be buried in routine cargo updates, where a navigator who understands how to ride storm shadows can slip a single line of truth into a sea of tolerated lies. Back on that nameless rock you found the first stray slate; now the derelict hull ahead offers the next fragment in a pattern everyone argues about, but no one dares investigate properly.
zh: 它始于此——一艘被扔在航道之间漂着的贸易管理局信使船，这里的官方信道稀薄，不合时宜的问题无人应答。"铁龙骨 TR-5394"在熟练的疏忽中漂着，它的应答器仍尽职地向一个假装没注意到的登记册发出讯号。正是在这里，对航线的悄悄修改可以被埋进例行的货物更新里；一个懂得如何乘着风暴阴影航行的领航员，能把一行真相溜进一片被容忍的谎言之海。在那块无名岩石上，你找到了第一块散落数据板；如今前方这具弃船船壳，提供了一个人人都争论、却没人敢认真调查的模式中的下一块碎片。

#en: Neon Starport is where water becomes invisible, pumped and cycled behind glass while tourists watch the rain that never falls. Out here, at the edge of the pads, Catalyst can vanish into freighters and service tunnels, one sealed hatch away from whatever final script she has queued into the city's veins. She came here to close her loop, to erase the last proof of whose contracts she broke and whose grids she rewrote, before shipping her archive somewhere no council can subpoena. Someone tried to bury all of this in sealed files and scrubbed logs, but a broken dataslate on a remote rock, rumors in Ebbside, and a nervous clerk in Cydonia kept the pattern alive.
zh: 霓虹城太空港是水变得看不见的地方——在被玻璃隔开的后方泵送、循环，而游客们看着那场永远不会落下的雨。在这里、在停机坪边缘，"催化剂"能消失在货船与服务隧道里，一道密封舱门之后，就是她排入这座城市血脉的最终脚本。她来这里是为了合上自己的循环，抹掉"她毁过谁的合同、改写过谁的电网"的最后证据，然后把她的档案运去某个任何议会都无法传唤的地方。有人试图把这一切埋进密封文件与被擦净的日志里，但偏远岩石上一块破碎的数据板、埃布赛德的传闻，以及赛多尼亚一名紧张兮兮的文书，让这个模式活了下来。

#en: Out on the edge of the lane, this maintenance beacon sits just far enough off the charted routes that nobody bothers to question its glitches. It quietly hands out bad timestamps, crooked handoffs, and tiny course corrections, and a thousand captains blame their own navs instead of the relay. If someone wanted to bend traffic around certain worlds without raising alarms, corrupting a node like this would be the first move. So far everything points the same way: the frozen colony whose distress calls arrived late, the survey cache whose coordinates never propagated, and the hushed talk of LIST approvals that somehow never reached the ships they were meant for.
zh: 在航道边缘，这座维护信标离已标注的航线足够远，远到没人会费心质疑它的故障。它悄悄发出错误的时戳、歪斜的交接和细微的航向修正，而一千名船长都怪自己的导航，而不是这座中继。若有人想在不动声色间把交通掰弯到绕开某些世界，腐蚀这样一个节点会是第一步。目前为止一切都指向同一方向：那座遇险呼叫迟到才送到的冰封殖民地、那座坐标从未传播出去的勘探缓存，以及关于独立盟批文不知怎地从未送到本该收到的船只上那些低声议论。

#en: Only a ship like this could hold what was left unfinished. The hull of the LX-6790 drifts in quiet defiance of every chart, its UC insignia scoured by time and micrometeorite dust, but her internal systems still whisper half-executed routines into the dark. Someone in the Navy brought her here on Luca's advice, started to align new corridors in secret, then never came back to confirm the math. Whatever sits buried in her nav banks is the missing pattern behind his hand on civilian routes and LIST homesteads alike. So far, the trail runs from a forgotten dataslate to the glow of Neon and into a lost scout's logs, each step tightening the orbit around his name.
zh: 只有这样一艘船才装得下那些未完成的东西。"LX-6790"的船壳在安静地违抗每一张星图，它的联殖徽记被时间与微陨尘磨蚀，可她的内部系统仍在向黑暗中低语着半途执行的程序。海军里有人听了卢卡的建议把她带到这里，开始秘密对齐新的走廊，然后再没回来确认那套数学。埋在她导航库里的东西，就是那只手伸向民用航线与独立盟农场时背后缺失的模式。目前为止，线索从一块被遗忘的数据板，延伸到霓虹城的辉光，再钻进一名失踪侦察兵的日志，每一步都收紧着围绕他名字的轨道。

#en: The old listening post hangs in the dark like a forgotten thought, its dishes still locked on starfields no one claims anymore. Somewhere in its cold racks, routine telemetry was nudged, recalibrated, overwritten, until a quiet sequence of numbers became the spine of a hidden corridor. This is where background noise turned into a roadmap, where abandoned UC hardware slowly bent toward someone else's purpose, and where a scavenger gang now guards data they barely understand. So far the trail has wound from a stray slate on a dead rock to corrupted courier logs in deep space, each fragment sketching the outline of one pilot who never stopped adjusting her own route.
zh: 那座旧听音哨像一段被遗忘的思绪悬在黑暗中，天线盘仍锁定在无人再主张的星野上。在它冰冷的机架某处，例行遥测被轻推、被重新标定、被覆写，直到一串安静的号码成了某条隐秘走廊的脊柱。这里正是背景噪声变成路线图的地方，是废弃的联殖硬件慢慢弯向别人目的的地方，也是如今一群拾荒者守着他们几乎看不懂的数据的地方。目前为止，线索从死寂岩石上一块散落数据板，一路绕到深空中被损坏的信使日志，每一块碎片都在勾画同一名从未停止调整自身航线的飞行员的轮廓。

#en: Out here, between planets and patrol grids, the only things that linger are broken rock, dead hardware, and whatever a grav jump leaves behind in the dark. This cache sits exactly where a long-haul route bent wrong years ago, sifting echoes out of passing drives, bottling every anomaly Vector ever cast across this orbit. Left alone, it keeps feeding quiet corrections back into the lanes, nudging ships a little closer to the same invisible corridor she vanished down.  \n\nSo far I have a buried cache on a forgotten rock, a silenced relay in orbit, redacted oversight files, and improvised power work at Gagarin all pointing to the same off-chart path through jump space.
zh: 在这里，在行星与巡逻网格之间，唯一会滞留的只有破碎的岩石、死掉的硬件，以及引力跃迁在黑暗中留下的一切。这座储藏点恰好位于多年前一条长途航线弯错的地方，从过往的引擎中筛出回声，把"向量"曾投在这条轨道上的每一处异常都装进瓶里。任其自生自灭，它会不断把安静的修正喂回航道，把船只一点点推向她消失其中的那条看不见的走廊。  \n\n目前为止，我有一颗被遗忘岩石上的埋藏储藏点、一座轨道上被噤声的中继、一批被涂黑的监督文件，以及加加林星上临时拼凑的电力工程，全都指向同一段穿过跃迁空间的偏航路径。

#en: Smugglers turned a forgotten diagnostics wing into a permanent backchannel, and the scribbled corrections traded here have been guiding jumps longer than anyone will admit. What started as a stopgap patch for bad routes has solidified into an unspoken standard, carried in contraband firmware and off-the-record experiments the Voltage Hackers protect for profit. Breaking that habit at the source is the only way to see which ships, which lanes, have been quietly rewritten in Vector's image. So far, the trail runs from a dusty outpost log, to a crooked orbital relay, to Gagarin's altered manifests and a rumor-soaked underbelly where "temporary" fixes never seem to get removed.
zh: 走私者把一座被遗忘的诊断翼楼变成了一条永久暗渠，在此交易的手写修正引导跃迁的时间，比任何人愿意承认的都久。起初只是为坏航线打的临时补丁，如今已固化成一条不成文的标准，装在违禁固件与不记录在案的实验里，由"电压黑客"为牟利而守护。从源头打断这个习惯，是看清哪些船、哪些航道已被悄然按"向量"的模样改写的唯一办法。目前为止，线索从一份积灰的前哨日志，延伸到一座歪斜的轨道中继，再到加加林星被改动的舱单，以及一个浸透传闻、那些"临时"修补似乎永远不会被撤掉的下层世界。

#en: Relays like this were built to stitch official corridors together, but with the dishes frozen and the consoles running on scavenged power, it has become something else a dead node where unapproved routes can be spliced in without oversight. Whoever has been feeding her data needed a quiet hinge in the network, a place to copy, cut, and redirect until no two manifests agree on who changed the course first, and the Rustbelt Scrappers are only too happy to defend the ambiguity for a fee. So far the trail runs from a hushed tribunal in the capital to shaken convoy logs and Neon's backroom ledgers, each arguing over details but circling the same unseen pilot reshaping the lanes.
zh: 像这样的中继本是用来把官方走廊缝合在一起的，可天线盘冻结、控制台靠拾来的电力运转之后，它变成了别的东西——一个死掉的节点，未经批准的航线可以在此不经监督地接进来。一直在给她喂数据的那个人，需要网络里一个安静的铰链，一处可以复制、剪切、重定向的地方，直到没有任何两份舱单在"谁先改了航向"上还能对上；而"锈带拆解队"只要有钱，就乐意捍卫这种模糊。目前为止，线索从首都一场压低声音的法庭，延伸到动摇的护航日志与霓虹城的密室账册，各方在细节上争吵不休，却都绕着同一名重塑航道的隐形飞行员打转。

#en: The sensor hub hanging over this world has been listening too well for too long. Its arrays should be blind with age, yet its logs keep catching the same faint distortion on different patrol routes, from different captains, always cutting through the same thin slice of orbit. Leaving it up means every faction with a clearance badge can keep quietly rewriting whatever it hears, turning his trail into random noise whenever it suits them. So far everything points the same way a dead buoy with missing minutes, a sideways scar in a farm field, Neon whispers about "temporary" routes, and now this station hearing the same wrong note often enough that chance stopped being an excuse.
zh: 悬在这颗世界上方的传感器中枢，听东西听得太清楚、也太久了。它的阵列本该因年岁而失明，可它的日志却不断在不同的巡逻航线、不同的船长身上捕捉到同一种微弱畸变，而且总是穿过轨道上同一片薄薄的区域。让它继续挂着，就等于让每一个持有许可徽章的派系都能悄悄改写它所听到的一切，在合适的时候把他的痕迹变成随机噪声。目前为止一切都指向同一方向：一座丢失了几分钟的浮标、一道横在农田里的伤疤、霓虹城关于"临时"航线的低语，以及如今这座星际站如此频繁地听到同一个错音，以至于是巧合已经说不通了。

#en: Ryujin Tower is where Ghostline bled his numbers into policy, turning abstract risk into quiet directives that decided which colonies lived long enough to fail. Beneath the glass and chrome, the internal servers and secured archives hold the only unfiltered record of how his refinements threaded through corporate agritech models and off-the-books contracts, masking sabotage as market correction. If his pattern is written anywhere, it is here, buried behind access lists and deniable agreements no frontier clerk could ever see. So far, all anyone truly has are rumors, half-sanitized logs from a dead ice colony, and whispered testimonies traded in back rooms and over bad coffee.
zh: 龙神大楼，就是"幽灵线"把他的数字渗进政策的地方，把抽象的风险变成安静的指令，决定着哪些殖民地活得够久、以至于能走向失败。在玻璃与铬合金之下，内部服务器与安全档案库保存着唯一未经筛选的记录，显示他的修正如何穿过公司的农业技术模型与账外合同，把破坏伪装成市场校正。如果他的模式被写在任何地方，那就是这里——埋在访问名单与可否认协议之后，任何边境文书都永远看不到。目前为止，所有人真正拥有的只是传闻、某座死寂冰封殖民地被半清理过的日志，以及在密室与劣质咖啡之间交换的低语证词。

#en: The maintenance garage hums with old machinery and cheap music, a place where no one expects anything important to happen and everyone insists nothing ever does. That makes it perfect cover for a quiet rewrite of history, tucked in a forgotten core under the Static Hackers' bored stares and flickering holo-graffiti. If there is any trace of what really happened to the injured tech, it is buried in those corrupted records, waiting for someone stubborn enough to dig past the static. So far there is only hearsay: a too-clean table, missing chems, and a handful of workers who cannot agree whether a foreign-accented medic ever stood where they are so sure nothing unusual occurred.
zh: 这间维修车库因老旧机械与廉价音乐而嗡鸣，是个没人指望会发生要紧事、而所有人都坚称什么事都不会发生的地方。这让它成了悄悄改写历史的完美掩护，被塞进一个被遗忘的核心——就藏在"静电黑客"们无聊的目光与闪烁的全息涂鸦之下。若说那名受伤技工究竟遭遇了什么还有一丝痕迹，它就埋在这些损坏的记录里，等着某个固执到愿意挖穿静电的人。目前为止只有道听途说：一张干净得过分的桌子、失踪的药剂，以及几名工人——他们无法就"是否真有一个带外国口音的医疗兵站过他们如此确定没发生过任何异常的地方"达成一致。

#en: If anyone is still keeping honest records about how frontier haulers have been quietly rearming, they are in HopeTown, buried between cargo manifests and maintenance orders written in the same worn hands that bolt engines together. This is where contracts blur into favors and favors into silence, where shipwrights remember which freighter asked for unusual hardpoints, then stop mid-sentence and just say "that one from Montara" with a tilt of the head instead of a name. So far the trail runs from a forgotten cache in the wilds to a dead terminal in an abandoned lab, each step narrowing toward a single freight route everyone seems to recognize, yet no one will speak of directly.
zh: 若说还有人仍在如实记录边境货船如何悄悄重新武装，那些人就在霍普镇——夹在货运舱单与维修订单之间，写它们的，正是那些拧引擎螺栓的、同样磨旧了的手。在这里，合同模糊成人情，人情模糊成沉默；造船师记得哪艘货船要过不寻常的挂点，却会在句子中间停住，只是歪歪头说"蒙塔拉来的那艘"，而不给名字。目前为止，线索从荒野中一座被遗忘的储藏点，延伸到一座废弃实验室里死掉的终端，每一步都收窄到一条似乎人人都认得、却没人愿意直接提起的货运航线。

#en: The listening post sits dead in the frost, but its dishes still point toward corridors no official chart admits exist. This is where she tuned stolen beacons against UC sensor ghosts, where she could ride the edge of their blind spots and erase herself between pings. The husk of UC authority around you makes it the only place her past and present overlap cleanly enough to cut through the lies; the same consoles that once tracked her will now decide whether she disappears for good. The trail here has been narrow but relentless: an anonymous dataslate, a gutted Trade Authority courier, and encrypted UC logs all circling the same quiet name and the same pattern of vanished ships.
zh: 那座听音哨死寂地立在冰霜中，可它的天线盘仍指向官方星图不肯承认存在的走廊。她曾在这里把偷来的信标调校成对抗联殖传感器幽灵的工具，在这里她可以贴着他们盲点的边缘航行，在两次脉冲之间把自己抹掉。环绕着你的联殖权威残骸，让这里成了她的过去与现在唯一能干净重叠、足以切穿谎言的地方；那些曾追踪过她的控制台，如今将决定她是否就此永远消失。这里的线索狭窄却执着：一块匿名数据板、一艘被掏空的贸易管理局信使船，以及被加密的联殖日志，全都绕着同一个安静的名字、同一个船只消失的模式打转。
